steps.title: Request
steps.text: Leave your phone number, name, city and venue name. A manager will get in touch.

steps.title: Demo
steps.text: We show you the platform on a demo venue and go through what you need: reports, POS and the tools to connect.

steps.title: POS connection
steps.text: We connect your POS and the other data sources your venues already use.

steps.title: Team kick-off
steps.text: A kick-off session for your team: roles and access, reports and Telegram summaries.

steps.title: Live
steps.text: Your venues run on VILAX every day, with summaries delivered to Telegram.

included.title: What standard onboarding includes
included.text: With annual billing: one supported connection, user access set-up and a kick-off session for your team. Anything else is quoted separately.
